reportSummary: This Health & Beauty audience, while upper-middle income nationally, earns 4.5% *less* than the typical online shopper with a median income of $81,407, indicating a discerning yet value-conscious approach to their purchases. Primarily suburban homeowners (48% homeowners, $478,946 median home value) in markets like Washington D.C. and Atlanta, this is a family-focused group with 3.2 people per household and 39% married. Crucially, with 45% being STEM-educated and tech-savvy, they are highly analytical consumers who will respond best to data-backed claims and transparent ingredient lists, rather than purely aspirational messaging.

reportSummary: "This 'Hairdressing & Cosmetology' audience stands out as significantly more value-conscious than the average online shopper, with a median income 18% lower than the Commerce Baseline. Primarily suburban homeowners in markets like Washington D.C. and Jersey City, this family-focused segment (3.3 people per household, 37% married) is typically aged 40-49, settling into established lives. Despite their value-conscious nature and a strong trade-skilled background (17.2% lower education vs. baseline), a surprising 73% overlap with 'Network Software' and 43% STEM education reveals a highly tech-savvy and digitally connected audience, suggesting sophisticated online engagement beyond typical expectations."
